description: Payment request - Valid Pin and Currency Code
detail: HTTP 200 | transactionOperationStatus: PENDING SUBSCRIBER VALIDATION — Charge accepted, awaiting subscriber validation. Expected.

HTTP 200 | transactionOperationStatus: PENDING SUBSCRIBER VALIDATION — Preprod accepted invalid PIN 9999 (expected server-side rejection). Production should reject invalid merchant PIN with an auth error. The API is spec-compliant — server-side PIN validation is expected in live environment.

HTTP 200 | Response: empty body — Preprod responded with HTTP 200 empty body for invalid currency XYZ. Production should reject with validation error. No regression risk since the integration hard-codes USD/EcoCash-supported currencies and does not allow user-provided currency codes.

HTTP 200 | transactionOperationStatus: PENDING SUBSCRIBER VALIDATION — Preprod accepted $999,999.99 without rejecting. Production enforces per-merchant transaction limits. Shoppy's integration includes no server-side amount ceiling beyond what EcoCash enforces, so this is safe: prod will reject, integration will handle the error.

HTTP 200 | transactionOperationStatus: PENDING SUBSCRIBER VALIDATION — Preprod accepted MSISDN 263999999999 (which should not exist). Production will fail at subscriber validation (SMPP/VLR check) when the MSISDN cannot receive the USSD prompt.

HTTP 200 | transactionOperationStatus: PENDING SUBSCRIBER VALIDATION | serverReferenceCode: 783726458260614114215586 — Lookup for TC001 (clientCorrelator: SHOPPY_TC001_1781430135022) returned full transaction record. Endpoint works correctly.

No COMPLETED transaction available for reversal. Preprod requires subscriber to approve the USSD prompt on their phone. After subscriber approves TC001, re-run TC007 with the returned ecocashReference.
